question: How is the māyā-seed characterized in contrast to the qualityless syllables?
premises: The māyā-seed is introduced with contrast
It is described as with quality
It is described as united with śiva and śakti
inference: The māyā-seed is with qualities and united with śiva and śakti.
plain_english: But the māyā-seed, O beloved, is with qualities and united with śiva and śakti.
